verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of version-control integration, diffable/text-based asset formats, scene merging, or built-in multi-user collaboration tooling for Unreal projects. Unreal's known binary .uasset/.umap formats and Perforce-centric workflows are not addressed at all in the provided docs or community items, so there is no evidence the capability is delivered. Missing for 10: any docs on Git/Perforce integration, diffable text formats, multi-user editing/collaboration tools, or scene-merge tooling.
